resources.string: No computed value yet. A power value (ch) is computed by the app from a torque (N·m) and an engine speed (rpm) of this profile\'s ECUs.

Power = torque × engine speed ÷ 9549 × 1.36, in ch. 0 when the torque is negative (engine braking); no value when the two are more than 2 s apart. Its two inputs are read and count toward the profile\'s values.
%1$s is shown on cards (%2$d) and in graphs (%3$d). Delete it together with them?
Add this profile\'s ECUs first: the torque and the engine speed are picked among their values.
Computed values per profile: at most %1$d.
